thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging ENG-Oncall (Sasha). Detected spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings-batch and downstream reranker errors. Customer-facing requests failing intermittently. Auto-mitigation: throttling traffic to batch endpoint by 30%.

Sasha: Acked. I'm oncall. Starting triage — how many customers affected? any obvious changelogs in the last 30m?

Jin: Seeing the same. Initial numbers: ~1200 failed requests in the last 10m, error rate ~18% for batch endpoint. Reranker errors show "vector_length_mismatch" in logs.

Sasha: Copy. @Jin can you paste the sample logs and the exact error stack? Need a timeline for the RCA.

Jin: Pasting short log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z embedder[v3] INFO request_id=abc123 payload_count=32 vector_dim=1024
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z reranker[v2] ERROR request_id=abc123 error=vector_length_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z routing WARN fallback_to_small_batch model_variant=bert-small
```

Maya: Noted — expected dims are 1536 for reranker v2 according to manifest (model-configs/reranker/v2.json). Why would embedder emit 1024? Any recent quantization/packing changes?

Samir: I just deployed a small change to batch packing 20m ago that reduces padding by grouping sequences tighter (PR #4823). It should not change vector dim but might swap which embedder binary is used if capacity shift happened.

Eli: Pulling trace of the failing request_id=abc123 across services: 
- 09:11:58 user -> api-gateway -> embeddings-batch (node-eu-3)
- 09:12:03 embeddings-batch invoked embedder:v3 (binary sha: d4c2f)
- 09:12:03 embedder returned tensor shape (32,1024)
- 09:12:04 reranker received payload and compared against model signature expecting (32,1536) -> failed

Sasha: Good timeline. Hypotheses to test (initial):
1) Model mismatch: reranker config updated to expect 1536 but embedder still producing 1024 (version skew/manifest drift).
2) Fallback embedder binary served (older model) due to node-level image mismatch after rolling update.
3) Batching/packing change truncated or projected embeddings accidentally (bug in packer).

Jin: Running quick job to sample the latest embedder instances: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embedder -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.labels.version}'` -> output: `v2 v3 v3` on node-eu-2 and node-eu-3. Checking image SHAs now.

Jin: Image SHAs: node-eu-3 embedder:v3 -> sha d4c2f (expected). node-eu-2 embedder:v2 -> sha a9b10 (old). But majority of traffic is hitting node-eu-3 which reports 1024 output. So it's not just a stale binary.

Samir: The packer change shouldn't alter dims. I'm re-reading the packer diff: there was a rewrite for contiguous buffers, and one line accidentally used `embedding_bytes = embedding_bytes[:int(embedding_bytes_len * 0.66)]` in a guard — looks suspicious. Reopening PR to revert.

Maya: Good catch — if the packer slices bytes that would explain reduced dims. Can you push a quick revert and snapshot the node? If we can reproduce in staging that confirms hypothesis 3.

Samir: Rolling back packer change now to canary nodes in eu region: `kubectl set image deployment/emb-packer packer=packerv1:stable` -> observing traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Samir for deployment/emb-packer -> packerv1:stable. 3/3 pods updating.

Jin: After revert, sampled request abc123 again (new request id=def456). Logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:22:11Z embedder[v3] INFO request_id=def456 payload_count=32 vector_dim=1536
2026-03-15T09:22:12Z reranker[v2] INFO request_id=def456 score=0.87
```

Eli: Nice — early signs look good. Error rate dropped from 18% -> 1.4% in the last 5m for that endpoint. Continuing sampling across nodes.

Sasha: Mitigation summary so far: throttled batch endpoint by 30% (auto), canaried revert of packer change -> appears to restore dims. Next: build timeline for RCA, gather all related PRs, snapshot nodes and images, collect full log pack for postmortem.

Maya: I'll take the handoff at 10:00UTC. @Sasha please include the list of affected customers and the ticket ids so I can continue customer comms.

Sasha: Will compile affected tenants list and initial customer impact blurb. Early estimate: 3 paid customers seen >5% error rate, some low-volume webhooks retried successfully. No data loss reported.

Samir: Root cause hypothesis (working): accidental slice in packer rewrite reduced embedding byte length in-edge deployments, producing 1024-d vectors instead of 1536. Revert on canary fixed it.

Jin: Additional evidence: CI for embedder had a test that asserts output dims but it only ran on the golden path; adding a unit test to assert packing does not truncate bytes and adding an integration test with reranker signature match. PR incoming (#4837).

Eli: Saving logs bundle: https://logs.redwood.company/incident/1939998887 (redacted). Timeline notes and trace links added to the incident doc.

Sasha: Thanks team. Handoff plan: Maya will own follow-up RCA, collect PRs (#4823, #4837), confirm customer notifications, and coordinate longer-term mitigation (schema enforcements and e2e sig checks). I'll mark this as acknowledged and move to status: mitigated.

Maya: Taking over. Will open postmortem draft and tag eng/runtime, eng-ml, and devex. Adding action items: 1) Add CI checks for output dim signatures; 2) Add runtime guard to reject mismatched vectors with explicit metric and auto-rollback; 3) Postmortem and customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated by Sasha. Handoff to Maya at 2026-03-15T10:00:00Z.

Sasha: Closing live thread for now — will update incident doc with final RCA once PRs land. :thumbsup:
